commit_message: Fix ADR 0125 VFX validation and visual capture
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0125 VFX authoring workflow
pr_body:
## Summary

- completes typed VFX module property, curve, gradient, texture-sheet, and template authoring on top of the existing `VfxAuthoringService`
- adds deterministic VFX Builder preview controls using the production CPU reference runtime, runtime stats, emitter-shape visualization, and live bounds
- adds shared-service VFX CLI and MCP inspect/validate/preview/apply/template surfaces with parity coverage
- fixes the affected Clippy findings and keeps the validation-only VFX capture unobstructed by AI Studio

## Validation

- Windows Validation: rerun required on the dispatcher-produced head
- Editor visual validation requested for the VFX Builder scenario
